items.title: Germany news: Gas reserves historically low ahead of winter
items.description: Gas storage operator association INES has warned that Germany's gas reserves could run out in the event of a cold winter. Meanwhile, fallout from the AfD's state election victory continues. Follow DW for the latest.

items.description: Despite fears of US wrecking tactics, the IMO says there have been "constructive discussions" over how to meet the industry's green targets The post London talks raise hopes for green shipping deal appeared first on Climate Home News.

items.title: Carbon capture tech exists. Scaling it up is the hard part
items.description: Europe just opened a carbon capture and storage plant billed as the continent's largest. But global climate scenarios call for far more capacity than exists anywhere on Earth.
